title: Vietnam produced 89.5Mt of cement in first nine months of 2026
summary: Vietnam produced 89.5Mt of cement in first nine months of 2026
body_markdown: **Vietnam:** The country produced an estimated 89.5Mt of cement in the first nine months of 2026, up by 10% year-on-year, according to the National Statistics Office. In September 2026, the country’s cement production reached 10.4Mt, up by 1% month-on-month and 12% year-on-year.
